coverage_assessment: Twelve captured open-web search calls contain 48 actual query strings and 238 ordered result headers. They cover English and Arabic general searches, all four February weekly windows, targeted Buraidah/Qassim reports, official-site and human-rights/wire checks, a Persian query, and a post-February continuity check. Twelve source cards remain search_only. Two unverified leads remain pending_evidence; one title-only online post is excluded as a standalone event and no continuation is verified. No source body was reviewed, and the search does not establish exhaustive, local-archive or regional/language coverage or absence of events.
body_access_note: No Saudi source body was dispatched/read in this phase. S001 chain aborts were preflight/mechanical, with zero body dispatch and no observed HTTP denial; S001 remains search_only. No Saudi URL is classified blocked or inaccessible.
